Name: LawMate DIY Portable WiFi Hidden Camera Module
Natural: Tiny DVR and Hidden Camera Module Perfect for Custom Designs The LawMate DIY Portable WiFi Hidden Camera Module allows you to create your own WiFi hidden camera using any object or appliance unique to the space where it will be set up. The options are nearly limitless! This tiny module is able to offer live streaming via the free mobile app which is compatible with iPhone and Android devices. You can customize video resolution (1080p, 720p, WGA), power on and off via the included remote, and utilize a variety of recording modes including auto, manual, and motion detection, giving you complete control over your surveillance recordings. Battery life on the device lasts for 240 minutes and video is stored on an included 16GB memory card. (Device supports up to 32GB memory card.)Due to federal regulations, this camera does not record audio. Click here to learn more.
